usdRate.sourceName: National Bank of Moldova official exchange rate
usdRate.note: MDL 18.0365 per US dollar on 31 October 2026 (EUR 20.0954); World Bank 2025 average 17.38.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: National Bureau of Statistics of Moldova, consumer price indices September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices 8.6% higher than in September 2025 (index 108.60); World Bank 2025 average 7.8%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: National Bank of Moldova inflation target 5% +/-1.5 points; CPI 8.6% (Sep 2026)
inflation_projection.note: The target is 5%, but inflation has run above it in most recent years (very high in 2022 and 8.6% now), so 5.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: National Bank of Moldova, monetary policy decision of 17 September 2026
policy_rate.note: Base rate raised from 7.5% to 9.00%; overnight deposit 7%, overnight loan 11%; next decision 5 November 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: National Bank of Moldova, bank deposit market in September 2026 (new interest-bearing demand deposits of individuals, MDL)
savings_account_rate.note: Average nominal rate on new interest-bearing demand (sight) deposits of individuals in lei 0.90%; foreign currency 0.83%.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: National Bank of Moldova, bank deposit market in September 2026 (new term deposits of individuals in MDL, up to 6 months)
fdr_3m_rate.note: BNM publishes rates by maturity band; 5.44% is the average for new lei term deposits of individuals with maturity up to 6 months (no separate 3-month figure).

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: National Bank of Moldova, bank deposit market in September 2026 (new term deposits of individuals in MDL, 6-12 months)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Average for new lei term deposits of individuals with maturity of 6 to 12 months; 1-2 years 6.50%; foreign-currency 6-12 months 1.24%.

dps_rate.note: Banks offer term deposits that accept regular top-ups, but BNM does not publish a rate for monthly recurring deposits and no official figure was found; lei term deposits of 2-5 years averaged 6.26% in September 2026 (BNM).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: National Bank of Moldova, bank deposit market in September 2026 (average rate on new term deposits of individuals, MDL)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average on all new lei term deposits of individuals; World Bank FR.INR.DPST 2025 average 4.76%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance of Moldova, placement of government securities by subscription to individuals (eVMS), 19 Oct - 2 Nov 2026
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Longest retail bond offered is 4 years at a fixed 8.05% (1 year 7.65%, 2 years 7.75%, 3 years 7.85%), interest paid every six months; no 5-year retail bond is offered.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance of Moldova, results of the government securities auction of 13 October 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average 3.07% on a small 91-day issue (MDL 31 million), far below the 182-day (11.07%) and 364-day (11.70%) bills sold the same day, so it is not representative of short-term yields.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance of Moldova, results of the government securities auction of 12 August 2026
tbond_5y_rate.note: Fixed-rate 5-year bond maturing 14 August 2031 placed at 7.95%.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance of Moldova, results of the government securities auction of 10 June 2026
tbond_10y_rate.note: Reopening of a 10-year bond (8.5 years left, maturing 13 December 2034) at 8.00%; no newer long-bond auction found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Moldova withholding taxes (reviewed 24 June 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: 6% final withholding on interest paid to resident individuals by banks; a draft 2027 tax package proposes raising it to 7%.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Moldova income determination (reviewed 24 June 2026)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest on state securities and local government bonds earned by resident individuals is tax-exempt.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Guarantee Fund in the Banking System (FGDSB), information for depositors
deposit_insurance_limit.note: MDL 200,000 per depositor per bank since 1 January 2025 (Law 160/2023), regardless of currency.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: Reports describe a draft law capping consumer-credit interest at 50% a year in lei, but it could not be confirmed as in force and no typical credit card rate was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No usable local stock index (Moldova Stock Exchange is tiny and illiquid); global equities in MDL
equity_return_low.note: Low case: global shares earn about 4% in dollars and the leu stays stable against the dollar.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity long-run return about 7% in USD; MDL 18.04 per USD (BNM); inflation target 5% vs 2% in the US
equity_return_base.note: No local market to invest in, so the base is a global index fund in lei: about 7% in dollars plus about 1.5% a year of expected leu depreciation, within 4 points of the tax-free 1-year retail bond (7.65%).

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run returns; leu depreciation of 2005-2025
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equity returns plus faster leu depreciation.

gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike and the leu stays stable.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); BNM 5% target vs 2% US inflation
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises about 4% a year and the leu loses about 1.5% a year against the dollar.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend plus faster leu depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Lei deposits 5.4-5.9% less 6% tax (BNM, Sep 2026); BNM base rate 9%
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: rates fall as inflation returns to the 5% target, leaving about 4.5% after tax on deposits.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Tax-free retail government bonds 7.65-8.05% (eVMS, Oct 2026); 1-year lei deposits 5.93% less 6% tax = 5.6%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of tax-free retail government bonds and deposits, allowing for some easing of rates.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: today's tax-free retail bond rates hold.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The National Bank of Moldova (insurance supervisor since July 2023) publishes insurance market statistics, but no life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Life insurance is a small market in Moldova (mostly credit-linked cover); no published premium table per MDL 1,000 of term cover by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Mandatory health insurance (CNAM) covers hospital care for the insured; no official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Voluntary health insurance is sold as fixed packages; no published premium table per MDL 100,000 of cover by age was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BNS CPI September 2026: health division +3.2%, medicines +4.1%, medical services +2.0% year on year
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices have recently risen slower than headline inflation, so the planning inflation rate of 5.5% is used rather than a premium.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BNS CPI September 2026: education division +8.4% year on year
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices are rising faster than headline inflation, so 7% is used.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 67.0, women 75.9 (UN WPP estimate for 2026); World Bank 2024 figure 71.3.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 26.5 (2025, World Bank), 30.0 (2040) and 38.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/republic-of-moldova/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Logos Press report on the 1 July 2026 retirement age step (Law 156/1998 on state social insurance pensions)
retirement_age_default.note: Men 63; women 62 from 1 July 2026, rising to 62.5 in July 2027 and 63 from 1 July 2028, so 63 applies to everyone born after 1975.

retirement_age_government.note: Law 158/2008 on public office ends service on reaching the pension age, but court rulings and local decisions also cite ages 63 and 65 for continued service; no single official figure could be confirmed.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposit and bond rates fall as inflation settles at the 5% target.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: 1-year lei deposits 5.93% less 6% tax = 5.6%; tax-free 1-year retail government bond 7.65% (eVMS)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the tax-free 1-year retail government bond rate, assuming a mix with deposits.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: today's tax-free retail bond rates hold for the long run.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax lei fixed income 4.5-6.5%; global equity low case 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if global shares lag and rates fall.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Tax-free retail government bonds about 7.7%; global equity in MDL 8.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half lei government bonds and deposits and half global shares in lei terms.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Retail government bonds 8%; global equity high case 11.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: National Social Insurance House (CNAS), beneficiaries of pensions and state social allowances at 1 January 2026
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: State social allowance for elderly people who do not qualify for a contributory pension (25,205 recipients, same amount for men and women); pensions and social benefits were indexed by 6.84% from 1 April 2026, which would make it about MDL 1,632, but no post-indexation figure was published.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: CNAS beneficiaries report (1 Jan 2026); retirement ages per Logos Press (1 July 2026)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Paid from the standard retirement age to people who do not meet the conditions for a contributory pension (e.g. too few contribution years); not income-tested. Women's age rises to 63 by July 2028.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity per year of service was found; the Labour Code provides severance pay only on dismissal for liquidation or redundancy, and the consolidated text could not be read to confirm other rules.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Moldpres: pensions and social benefits indexed by 6.84% from 1 April 2026; CNAS
public_pension_scheme.note: Mandatory pay-as-you-go state social insurance pension (CNAS) from age 63 (women 62, rising to 63 by 2028), indexed every 1 April (6.84% in 2026); minimum old-age pension MDL 3,264.66 with a full 34-year record (3,525.72 with 40 years).

savings_account.localName: Depozit la vedere / cont de economii

dps.note: Terms vary by bank; no published average rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.localName: Obligațiuni de stat pentru persoane fizice (eVMS)
sanchayapatra_5y.note: Fixed-rate bonds of 1-4 years sold directly to individuals by the Ministry of Finance every two weeks through the eVMS platform; interest is tax-exempt.

tbill_91d.note: 91-, 182- and 364-day bills auctioned by the Ministry of Finance through the National Bank.

equity_fund.note: No domestic diversified retail mutual or index funds were found; the local stock exchange is very small.

insuranceRegulator.name: National Bank of Moldova (insurance supervision since 1 July 2023)

insuranceComplaints.name: National Bank of Moldova: where to turn when your rights as a consumer of financial services are breached
insuranceComplaints.note: Consumer-protection complaints about insurers go to the National Commission for Financial Markets (CNPF).

oldAgeAllowance.name: National Social Insurance House (CNAS), state social allowances

publicHealthCover.name: National Health Insurance Company (CNAM), mandatory health insurance

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Guarantee Fund in the Banking System (FGDSB)

statistics.name: National Bureau of Statistics of the Republic of Moldova
